title: Incidències
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: This volume offers an approach to Catalan contemporary poetry, from the point of view of its impact, that is, its potential to go beyond the limits of the printed book and be present in the public sphere. The social relevance of poetry is not only related to the number of readers. It also has to do with its ability to produce in uences, to inspire pedagogical practices, to modify worldviews, or to disseminate through different media beyond the published book.
